bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 6" x 9" are allowed. All bags are searched at entry.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutches up to 6" x 9" (do not need to be clear)
prohibited: Non-clear bags larger than a clutch
Strollers, wagons and other wheeled devices (mobility devices excepted)
bagPolicy.note: Bags or small coolers needed for medical supplies are allowed after a brief inspection and tagged as medical bags. No re-entry.
